name: Transition to adulthood
source:
The main character Jess is sent by her friends to the resort town in Canada to celebrate the end of high school. They'd found an old beachfront holiday house
for rent.
Jess recently broke up with her boyfriend and is looking for a new hot relationship.

You will get acquainted with 9 characters of the novel. The story line will tell you about a get-together at the campfire on the beach, an adult game of spin-bottle, a yacht trip to the island and a loud disco.

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
主角杰西被她的朋友送到加拿大的度假小镇庆祝高中结束。他们找到了一栋古老的海滨度假屋
出租。
杰西最近与男友分手，正在寻找新的热门关系。

你将熟悉小说中的9个角色。故事情节将讲述海滩篝火聚会、成人转瓶游戏、游艇海岛之旅和喧闹的迪斯科。

[来自Steam（已删除）]
